name: Charger
description: Build Momentum while sprinting on foot. Momentum I, II, and III are reached after 4, 8, and 12 blocks. Stopping causes one tier to decay every 2 seconds. While sprinting with Momentum, colliding with a creature consumes all Momentum, knocks it back, and stuns it for 0.5, 1.0, or 1.5 seconds based on tier; Martial Spells stun resistance and immunity rules apply.
